title: isodon effusus f. leucanthus
intro: Isodon effusus f. leucanthus, commonly known as Himalayan isodon, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae, native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan isodon include analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan isodon include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
